audit.whatIsWrong: The level-chart enums disagree with the packet AND with the page's own prose. win[0]/phases[0].side say Wukong while whys[0] says 'Garen owns level 1'. Same at Level 2, Levels 4-5 and 2+ items.
audit.why: Packet chart: Garen, Garen, Skill, Wukong, Wukong, Skill, Skill. Win rate 48.64% over 884 games — Garen is slightly ahead overall, and his lead is the early one. The garen__wukong mirror has already been flipped to exactly these rows, so leaving this side would render two different answers.
audit.corrected: Rows 0, 1, 3 and 6 flipped in matched full/content pairs to Garen, Garen, Wukong, Skill, with ratings rescaled to the inverse of the mirror's (4/10, 4/10, 6/10, 5/10). The whys already read correctly and needed no change.

audit.why: Garen's spikes: Decisive Strike rank-ups (flat 8s), Courage scaling 22s down to 12s, level 6 Demacian Justice (120/100/80s, true damage execute), and early armour/health items. Wukong's are the level 4-5 clone window and Black Cleaver.
audit.corrected: spikes[] entries are accurate; spikes[0] reworded to make the silence timing the cue.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page says the clone makes the Q silence 'whiff', which reverses the actual sequencing problem. Decisive Strike silences — once the empowered auto lands you cannot cast Warrior Trickster at all. The clone only saves you if it is already out.
audit.why: Riot's Q text: 'His next attack strikes a vital area of his foe, dealing bonus damage and silencing them.' The kit flags it silence: 'denies ability casts'. Q is a flat 8s cooldown, so the gap is trackable.
audit.corrected: The clone must go out BEFORE the empowered auto lands, never after; Q is up every 8s, so trade in that gap. Courage is 22s at rank 1 (shield plus tenacity, then damage reduction) — that is the other window.

audit.whatIsWrong: Courage is named as the tracked cooldown across the page but never given a number, so 'burst when it's down' has no timer attached.
audit.why: Courage is 22/19.5/17/14.5/12s — a 22-second hole at rank 1, the single largest commit window in the lane.
audit.corrected: Number written into report[5].t and dontsFull[1].d.

audit.whatIsWrong: Courage's tenacity is never mentioned, only its damage reduction.
audit.why: Riot's W text explicitly grants 'a shield and tenacity for a brief moment' — that shortens your CC during exactly the window you want to commit in.
Nothing in the brief indicates a recent change to either kit on 26.15.

edits.before: Flip the lane at 4-5: E-Q clone trades let you dodge his Decisive Strike (Q) silence-empowered auto and Judgment (E) spin. When he Qs in, W into a clone so the silence and burst hit nothing, then Crushing Blow his low armor.
edits.after: Flip the lane at 4-5: his Decisive Strike (Q) silence denies casts, so the clone must go out BEFORE the empowered auto lands, never after. Q is up every 8s — trade in that gap, then Crushing Blow shreds his low armour.

edits.before: Track Garen's Courage: Damage reduction. Burst when it’s down. When it is down — E-Q + R him.
edits.after: Courage: 22s at rank 1, shield then damage cut. Burst in that gap — his Q silence beats a late W.

edits.before: That is Garen's favourite window — refuse it and half his win condition is gone.
edits.after: Decisive Strike silences you — once it lands you cannot cast the clone at all.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Courage cuts your damage and grants tenacity — wait out its 22s.

notes: The packet flags 'Decisive Strike's' in early as a probable wrong ability name — it is a FALSE POSITIVE, that is Garen's real Q name and the possessive tripped the matcher. The level chart was the real defect: both layers said Wukong owns Level 1 while the page's own whys[0] said 'Garen owns level 1'. Flipped rows 0/1/3/6 in matched pairs to the packet chart, which is also what the garen__wukong mirror was set to. The biggest mechanical correction is the silence ordering — the page implied the clone dodges the silence, when in fact the silence prevents you from casting the clone at all.
